remarks: Welcome to 17 Erskine Road in Stamford, a spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bath home offering a great opportunity for its next owner. The property has been occupied by a long-term tenant and is ready for a new chapter, with plenty of potential to update, personalize, and make it your own. The home offers a flexible layout with four bedrooms and three full baths, providing plenty of room for a variety of living arrangements. Outside, you'll find off-street parking, a level yard, mature landscaping, and established garden areas, offering space to relax, entertain, or create your own outdoor retreat. Located in Stamford, the property combines a residential setting with convenient access to everything the city has to offer. Enjoy Stamford's wide variety of shopping, restaurants, parks, and recreational opportunities, along with easy access to major commuting routes. Downtown Stamford and the Stamford Transportation Center provide Metro-North and Amtrak service, making travel throughout Fairfield County and into New York City convenient. Whether you're looking for a home to renovate and customize or an opportunity to add value over time, 17 Erskine Road offers space, versatility, and potential in one of Fairfield County's most active communities. With its long-term tenant moving out, this is an excellent opportunity to bring your vision to this well-established Stamford property.
